title: HOPD: Historical On-Policy Distillation for SAR MLLM Continual Learning

authors: Yuxuan Li, Zichen Tian, and Qianru Sun

authors: Yuxuan Li, Yuming Chen, Yunheng Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li, and Jian Yang

summary: Structured-attribute vision–language pretraining that grounds fine-grained physical and geometric attributes for remote sensing object detection and cross-dataset transfer.
authors: Chenxu Wang, Yuxuan Li, Yunheng Li, Xiang Li, Jingyuan Xia, and Qibin Hou

authors: Yuxuan Li, Xiang Li, Weijie Li, Qibin Hou, Li Liu, Ming-Ming Cheng, and Jian Yang
